outcome: Close the MADR 0010 gap: every refusal carries what was received, what is accepted at that point, and a rewrite when mechanical; advice is attached for every semantic operation, raise sites carry the accepted shape in details with the step path kept, and each refusal family of the 2026-09-09 runs has a detector
criteria: Every BackendError leaving semantic_operation passes through advise_error with the call's arguments as written, and the failed operation record carries the same advice as the response; get_provenance, delete_dataset, import_dataset, attach_metadata and export_result refusals carry advice in tests

The raise sites for import format, unknown field, comparison type mismatch, measure without field, duplicate output field, invalid derive entry, expression parse error, expression as text measure, JSON text as source, unknown document and existing export file carry the accepted shape in details and keep the step path in field, asserted by tests, with the messages and details that existing tests pin unchanged

Each detector (document_as_dataset on import, join_scope_names, field_created_later, field_not_in_scope, compare_literal_type, measure_needs_field, aggregate_body_misplaced, function_as_infix, measure_as_object, source_as_dataset for JSON text and inline joins, document_not_found, file_exists, transform_as_text) has a test in tests/test_recovery.py that executes its rewrite where one exists and asserts no rewrite where similarity alone would produce one

A transform sent as malformed JSON text and a source sent as an object reach the backend through the MCP server and are refused with advice, not by the SDK with pydantic text, shown by tests in tests/test_mcp.py

Replaying the 21 unadvised refusals of the 2026-09-09 run records against the task workspaces reports 21 advised and every offered rewrite succeeding, and the replay table is recorded in the DataSpace README

README Failure semantics states the principle and the full detector inventory, section 7 item 8 is narrowed to scalar arguments, MADR 0010 gains a decision history entry through this outcome, and uv run pytest passes

note: Dispatch moved to the operation boundary: semantic_operation binds the call's arguments as written into a ContextVar and attaches advice to any BackendError that has none, and _operation attaches it before the failed record is written; advise_error became a registry of detectors with the tools they apply to and a fallback flag. Eleven raise sites now carry the accepted shape in details and keep the step path (tests/test_refusal_facts.py, 11 tests). Fourteen detectors added or extended (function_as_infix, measure_as_object, measure_needs_field, aggregate_body_misplaced, compare_literal_type, join_scope_names, field_created_later, field_not_in_scope as fallback, source_as_dataset for JSON text and inline joins, document_not_found, file_exists, transform_as_text, name_taken, document_as_dataset/media_as_dataset/unsupported_format on import), each with a test that executes its rewrite; look-alike names are never rewritten. registry.py types source and transform loosely so the backend refuses them with advice. Replay of the 2026-09-09 records through the MCP server: 21 of 21 previously unadvised refusals now advised, 18 of 18 rewrites succeed as sent; table in the DataSpace README. README Failure semantics states the three-part principle and the inventory; section 7 item 8 narrowed to scalar arguments; MADR 0010 has two history entries from this outcome. uv run pytest exit 0 (full suite).
